description:
Based on RVX Patches v5.4.1-dev.3.

Original changelogs:

- https://github.com/inotia00/revanced-patches/releases/tag/v5.2.2
- https://github.com/inotia00/revanced-patches/releases/tag/v5.3.1
- https://github.com/inotia00/revanced-patches/releases/tag/v5.4.1-dev.1
- https://github.com/inotia00/revanced-patches/releases/tag/v5.4.1-dev.2
- https://github.com/inotia00/revanced-patches/releases/tag/v5.4.1-dev.3

Fork changelogs:

- Fixed the issue that casting to TV crashes the app.
- ~~Separated `Disable update screen` patch from `Hide layout components` patch.~~
  - ~~This allows users to disable the force update screen while excluding "Hide layout components" patch.~~
  - **(EDITED)** I forgot to specify the compatible packages to this patches, and this patch becomes an universal patch accidentally.
  - So please apply `Hide layout components` to disable the update screen for now!
  - I'll fix in next time of release.

Known issues:

- RYD in Shorts is unstable. (When dislike count isn't shown in shorts, please scroll the short a bit.)
- "Disable engagement panel" (in fullscreen settings) also hides quick actions container.
- French and Korean translations are not included. (An issue of original [v5.4.1-dev.3](https://github.com/inotia00/revanced-patches/releases/tag/v5.4.1-dev.3))

Tools information:

- Compatible ReVanced CLI: [Official latest](https://github.com/ReVanced/revanced-cli/releases/latest) or [inotia00 latest](https://github.com/inotia00/revanced-cli/releases/latest) (v5.0.0+)
  - kitadai31 CLI fork has been discontinued. Use official or inotia00.
- Compatible ReVanced Manager: [Official latest](https://github.com/ReVanced/revanced-manager/releases/latest) or [RVX latest](https://github.com/inotia00/revanced-manager/releases/latest) (v1.23.0 or above)
- Compatible ReVanced Manager for A6-7 fork: Currently unavailable!

Important: Manager for A5-7 is still not ready yet!
